description: Water treatment plant in Phnom Penh is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Cambodia. This dataset shows the locations of water treatment plant in Phnom Penh which are under the operation of Phnom Penh Water Supply Authority. There are 4 locations in this dataset that are operating to supply clean water in Phnom Penh. Coverage: Cambodia. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Cambodia. Its tags are SDG6 Clean Water and Sanitation, Urban water and sanitation infrastructure, Urban water supplies and distribution. It offers 8 resource(s) in csv, geojson, jpeg, kml, shp. The portal shows 2019-10-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
